leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a stack data structure to track digits while processing the number string
Apply a greedy algorithm to remove digits that create larger subsequent numbers
Construct a function that iterates through digits and conditionally removes them based on stack comparisons
Manipulate string inputs to handle edge cases like leading zeros and empty results
Initialize and update a result string by converting the final stack contents
Control the removal process to ensure exactly k digits are removed when possible
Integrate all components to produce the smallest possible number after k removals
